name: Ren'ai Jakusha na Osananajimi Shoujo to Ren'ai Kyousha na Kanojo
original_name: 恋愛弱者な幼馴染少女と恋愛強者な彼女
source:
Sera Fuki and Katou Ui have been childhood friends since they were small children, and they were so close that they would go to each other's rooms through the window. This has not changed since Fuki became a university student and got himself a beautiful girlfriend, Aikawa Seira.

Even though their minds and bodies have matured enough, and they are secretly aware of each other as the opposite sex. Their relationship has never developed into a male-female one.

In particular, Ui has always had feelings for Fuki, but due to her natural shyness, she has never been able to show them off. When Fuki became a university student, he finally got a girlfriend and Ui was about to give up.

However, Fuki coming back home happened to witness Ui changing clothes. Moreover, Ui accidentally witnesses her best friend having sex. Their relationship gradually changes, from the platonic and stagnant relationship they had to one where they fully become aware of one another.

Seira, begins her plan to keep her beloved Fuki with her and to keep the thieving cat, Ui, in check.

[From the [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/104renai/#story]official site[/url]]
translation:
世良富贵和加藤衣从小就是青梅竹马，关系非常亲密，经常隔着窗户去对方的房间。自从Fuki成为一名大学生并为自己找到了一个美丽的女朋友Aikawa Seira以来，这一点就没有改变。

尽管他们的心智和身体已经足够成熟，而且他们都暗自意识到对方是异性。他们的关系从来没有发展成男女关系。

特别是，Ui一直对Fuki有感情，但由于她天生害羞，她一直无法将这种感情表现出来。当Fuki成为一名大学生时，他终于有了女朋友，而Ui正准备放弃。

然而，富贵回家时正好看到了衣换衣服。此外，Ui无意中目睹了她最好的朋友做爱。他们的关系逐渐发生变化，从柏拉图式、停滞不前的关系转变为完全相互了解的关系。

Seira开始了她的计划，让她心爱的Fuki陪伴在身边，并控制偷窃的猫Ui。

[来自[url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/104renai/#story]官方网站[/url]]
